editorial:
Imagine being left for dead on a planet millions of miles from home, with nothing but your brain and a few supplies to keep you alive. That is the wild setup here, where astronaut Mark Watney gets stranded on Mars after a storm and has to figure out how to survive. The movie follows his clever, funny, and sometimes scary journey as he grows food, fixes broken gear, and tries to contact Earth. You will love how the story mixes real science with humor, making you feel like you are right there with him on the red planet.

The acting is fantastic, especially the lead, who makes you laugh even when things look hopeless. The pacing keeps you hooked from start to finish, with great visuals and a strong supporting cast back on Earth. On the downside, some science talk might feel heavy, but it never drags. If you enjoy smart, feel-good adventures, this one is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mark Watney launches himself into space using a modified rocket to reach his crew's ship. The crew risks everything to catch him during a dangerous spacewalk. They succeed, and Mark is rescued. Back on Earth, he becomes a teacher, sharing his survival story with students. The twist is that his crew never gave up on him, even when everyone else thought he was dead.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves smart survival stories and space adventures.
